recent.text: My @orlandosports recap as the #Magic snap a 4-game skid at the Kings behind Franz Wagner's 33 points: “We’ve seen some improvement in areas that we really wanted to improve upon … so to get the reward of the W is always great,” coach Sean Sweeney said. https://t.co/NvWTbtHffd
recent.author: Jason Beede

recent.text: Asked at Sacramento by @Josh_Cohen_NBA what’s impressed him the most lately about Franz Wagner, #Magic’s Anthony Black pointed to his ability to make his teammates better: Wagner is 3rd among the NBA’s official leaders in assists (8.6) after he recorded 7 more against the Kings. https://t.co/VFp22fNiOL
recent.author: Jason Beede

recent.text: “AB played great,” #Magic forward Franz Wagner told @Josh_Cohen_NBA at Sacramento about Anthony Black’s 26-point, 7-rebound, 5-assist performance against the Kings. “We need him to keep being aggressive and make plays going downhill.”
recent.author: Jason Beede

recent.text: “He does a great job of giving effort on both ends,” #Magic coach Sean Sweeney said about Orlando two-way forward Alex Morales. “… All the little things that you need to win, he does. He did that in the G for Osceola and has done it throughout his time … with us.” More: https://t.co/wK6aM0YXLP
recent.author: Jason Beede

recent.text: The #Magic shot a season-high 94% from the free throw line at Sacramento when Orlando ended 17-for-18 there. The 18 free throw attempts were the team’s second-fewest tries in a game this regular season. Franz Wagner was a perfect 10-for-10 at the line in the seven-point road win.
recent.author: Jason Beede

recent.text: LaVine is catching fire from 3 again and the #Kings are on an 8-0 run to make this a five-point game. #Kings have finally started doubling Franz Wagner to get the ball out of his hands. AB is on the bench after tweaking his ankle. Bane can't hit a shot. ORL 103:98 SAC 0:20.6 4th
recent.author: Orlando Magic Daily

recent.text: Desmond Bane is shooting 4 for 12 from three tonight. There have been a few bad looks -- a few fading-away corner shots -- but it is hard to hate most of his looks. #Magic are 5/27 from three since the first quarter. Need to make shots to beat real teams. ORL 101:90 SAC 3:08 4th
recent.author: Orlando Magic Daily

recent.text: The #Magic will have to find their way to win. It took longer than any of us wanted, but they are getting there. Another really strong game on the glass. Franz Wagner is in complete control on offense. Must get in the paint more. But the formula is there. ORL 99:90 SAC 4:31 4th
recent.author: Orlando Magic Daily

recent.author: Orlando Magic

recent.text: The #Magic were 5 for 6 from three in the first quarter. They are 3 for 14 since. Bane three makes it 4 for 15. Credit to the #Magic and Franz Wagner for getting to the paint. Offense is stalling when Franz is out without another driver. ORL 66:59 SAC 7:52 3rd
recent.author: Orlando Magic Daily

recent.text: Anthony Black in the first half vs Kings: 16 PTS 5/10 FG 4/4 FT +3 https://t.co/Atyr69ar0M
recent.author: Orlando Magic

recent.text: The #Magic gave up a 20-1 run earlier in the second quarter. That could break a lot of teams. The #Magic have answered and have restored the lead out to nine on a Franz Wagner three. Plenty to clean up, but that says something. ORL 52:43 SAC 3:10 2nd
recent.author: Orlando Magic Daily

recent.text: Franz is the best player in this game. And there is a long way before you get to No. 2 -- whether you want to say that is Acuff or Black, I will leave to you. Wagner has 11 points and five assists in 14 minutes. ORL 47:43 SAC 43 4:35 2nd
recent.author: Orlando Magic Daily

recent.text: The #Magic are settling down with Franz Wagner back in the game after the 20-1 run. They are back in front with a 7-0 run until the Acuff pull-up three. Got to make shots and find a way to touch the paint. ORL 42:43 SAC 6:07 2nd
recent.author: Orlando Magic Daily

recent.text: Franz Wagner with seven points and four assists. Found Jase Richardson sneaking behind the defense in transition for a nice layup. #Kings burn their second timeout of the quarter. #Magic have really been solid defensively. ORL 31:20 SAC 1:48 1st
recent.author: Orlando Magic Daily

recent.text: Yeah... Precious Achiuwa cannot stay in front of Franz Wagner. Just have to make sure the paint is clear and not turn the ball over. ORL 2:5 SAC 10:27 1st
recent.author: Orlando Magic Daily

recent.text: The #Magic are starting Anthony Black, Desmond Bane, Jamal Cain, Franz Wagner and Wendell Carter Jr. at Sacramento tonight.
recent.author: Jason Beede

recent.text: #Magic coach Sean Sweeney told reporters at Sacramento that Tristan da Silva (OUT; left calf strain) “started feeling a little tightness in his calf” after Saturday’s game at Golden State. Sweeney said with 3 games in 4 days, they wanted to be smart about it as he gets treatment.
recent.author: Jason Beede

recent.text: No Tristan da Silva tonight for the #Magic. Left calf strain could have him out for a bit too. We will see. Next man up.
